FlowerPainter.Hint.BrushEraseBuilt: Erase built area: release to remove only the brushed part.
FlowerPainter.Hint.BrushExtendBuilt: Extend built area: release to build the new ground in its existing style.
FlowerPainter.Mode.Draw.Tooltip: Click corners. Snaps to curbs, buildings and right angles.
FlowerPainter.Mode.Block.Tooltip: Click a city block to fill it. Shift+click adds more.
FlowerPainter.Mode.Paint.Tooltip: Brush it on, freely (Smart edges off). Right-click erases.
FlowerPainter.Mode.Perimeter.Tooltip: Click road corners around the area; the roads between are followed.
FlowerPainter.Mode.BlockPaint.Tooltip: Brush it on; it stops at roads, buildings, zoning and water (Smart edges). Right-click erases.
FlowerPainter.Problem.TooManyPoints: That is the most corners an outline can have.
FlowerPainter.Problem.NeedThreePoints: An area needs at least three corners.
FlowerPainter.Problem.TooSmallFor: Too small for this design (at least {0} m²).
FlowerPainter.Problem.TooLargeFor: Too large for this design (at most {0} m²).
FlowerPainter.Problem.OnOtherBuild: This outline lies on another FlowerPainter build. Move it, or turn off the brush rule "Other builds".
FlowerPainter.Problem.NoBlockHere: No block could be found here.
FlowerPainter.Problem.BlockFull: Nothing to paint in this block: it is zoned, built on or under water.
FlowerPainter.Problem.CannotPaintHere: Nothing can be painted here: it is a road, zoned, built on or under water.
FlowerPainter.Problem.NoRoadsNearby: No roads nearby. Use Draw or Paint here.
FlowerPainter.Problem.NotEnclosed: Not enclosed here. Turn on more walls (paths, tracks…) or use Points.
FlowerPainter.Problem.BlockTooLarge: This block is too large to pick. Use Draw or Paint.
FlowerPainter.Problem.NotAdjacent: Only blocks next to the selection can be added.
FlowerPainter.Problem.WouldEncloseHole: Areas cannot have holes: that would enclose a block you did not pick.
FlowerPainter.Problem.WouldSplit: Removing that block would split the selection in two.
FlowerPainter.Problem.PerimeterClosed: The loop is closed. Right-click to reopen it.
FlowerPainter.Problem.NoRoadPath: These intersections are not connected by roads.
FlowerPainter.Problem.NodeAlreadyUsed: The loop already passes through there.
FlowerPainter.Problem.SaveFailed: The design could not be saved.
FlowerPainter.Problem.CannotDeleteRecipe: Only your own designs can be deleted.
FlowerPainter.Problem.PresetSaveFailed: The preset could not be saved.
FlowerPainter.Problem.CannotRenamePreset: Only your own presets can be renamed.
FlowerPainter.Problem.CannotEdit: This area cannot be edited (its design was not stored).
FlowerPainter.Hint.BlockReplace: Click elsewhere to fill there instead
FlowerPainter.Hint.DefaultsSaved: Saved as the default for this layer.
FlowerPainter.Issue.PlanFailed: The layout could not be planned: {0}
FlowerPainter.Issue.PlanTimeout: Planning took longer than {0} s and was stopped. Try a smaller area.
FlowerPainter.Issue.KeptOffRoads: The area was trimmed to keep off existing roads ({0} m² left out).
FlowerPainter.Issue.AreaSplitByRoad: A road runs through the area: the largest part is used, {0} smaller part(s) ({1} m²) left out. Select them separately if you want them too.
FlowerPainter.Issue.BuildFailedNext: Red circles show where it went wrong. Adjust the outline or the settings and build again, or go back. The circles disappear as soon as you change something.
FlowerPainter.Permanent.Terraform: Reshapes the ground (about {0} m²). This stays even if you remove the build later.
FlowerPainter.Permanent.Water: Digs a pond or lake (about {0} m²). The hollow stays even if you remove the build later.
FlowerPainter.Settings.BrushPaintOverAny: Paint area paints over roads, buildings, zoning and water, ignoring the stops below.
FlowerPainter.Settings.BrushStopRoads.De: The brush stops at the curb and never paints across a road.
FlowerPainter.Settings.BrushStopBuilding: The brush keeps off building lots.
FlowerPainter.Settings.BrushStopBuilds.D: Every area tool keeps off what you built with FlowerPainter (except the one being edited).
FlowerPainter.Settings.BrushStopLots.Des: The brush keeps off parks, other mods' lots and lot areas.
FlowerPainter.Settings.BrushStopZoned.De: The brush keeps off zoned cells that have a building (or one being built). Vacant zoned land stays paintable.
FlowerPainter.Settings.BrushStopAllZoned: The brush also keeps off zoned cells nobody has built on yet.
FlowerPainter.Settings.BlockPaintAvoidEm: The brush also keeps the empty zone grid free.
FlowerPainter.Settings.BrushStopWater.De: The brush keeps off water deeper than wading depth.
A Paint area stroke stays inside the block where it started.
FlowerPainter.Settings.BrushDrawClip.Des: Points, Paint bucket and Road nodes outlines are cut back to free land using the stops above.
FlowerPainter.Settings.BrushSnapDistance: Painted edges this close to a curb or obstacle snap onto it; 0 = off.
FlowerPainter.Settings.BrushSmoothing.De: How smooth the painted edge is: 0 keeps the brush cells, 6 is smoothest.
FlowerPainter.Settings.ResetBrushRules.D: Puts every edge rule back to its default.
FlowerPainter.Settings.ClearExistingTree: Removes trees, plants, props and decals inside the area when it is built, so nothing old pokes through. Buildings, utilities and roads are never touched.
FlowerPainter.Settings.KeepZonedBuilding: Blocks the roads' zone cells under a park, plaza or other build (except its zoning cutouts), so the city cannot grow houses or shops on it. Removing the build unblocks them again. Off: the land under a build stays zonable.
FlowerPainter.Settings.RecoverRejectedPi: If the game refuses some pieces, repair or leave out just those and build the rest. FlowerPainter tells you what was skipped.
FlowerPainter.Settings.OverlayPavedSurfa: Paving, asphalt and plaza surfaces are drawn on top of grass instead of flickering with it.
Leaves, stains and wear decals are built mostly transparent so they blend with the ground. Turn off if decals look wrong.
FlowerPainter.Settings.DecalsNeverCollid: Leaves, stains and other ground decals lie under trees, benches and paths instead of being hidden where they overlap. Turn off if decals do not show.
FlowerPainter.Settings.ChargeNetConstruc: Roads and paths cost what the game charges for them, like when you draw them yourself.
FlowerPainter.Settings.SelectAsOneThing: Select and bulldoze as one thing
Clicking any part of a built lot, park or plaza selects the whole build; bulldozing removes it all. Applies to new builds.
After every build, writes the terrain heights before and after, the water depth and the built paths and objects around it to ModsData/FlowerPainter/debug as a JSON file, for checking the result offline (the gallery renders it). Off normally.
FlowerPainter.Settings.ConfirmBulldoze: Ask before bulldozing a whole build
FlowerPainter.Settings.ConfirmBulldoze.D: Shows the game's confirmation before a FlowerPainter build is bulldozed.
FlowerPainter.Settings.AutoExcludeCollis: Only when collisions are not ignored: decorative pieces the game refuses are left out (listed in the build report) instead of refusing the whole build.
FlowerPainter.Settings.IgnoreOwnCollisio: Build everything you planned, like the Anarchy mod: the game's overlap and shape checks never refuse or remove pieces of a FlowerPainter build. Existing buildings are never demolished.
FlowerPainter.Settings.SurfaceClones.Des: Lets planned ground surfaces show on top of road decals where they meet.
FlowerPainter.Settings.TexturedPreviewSu: Shows ground surfaces in the 3D preview with their real texture. Changes how the game batches surfaces for rendering; off by default until verified stable.
FlowerPainter.Settings.ParkingEconomy.De: Parking lots built with FlowerPainter charge a parking fee and count as parking in the city.
FlowerPainter.Settings.ExperimentalParki: Adds an invisible service building to parking lots so they show up in city statistics. Experimental.
FlowerPainter.Settings.CompanionUpkeepFa: Multiplies the upkeep of the parking lot service building.
FlowerPainter.Settings.ShowCursorTooltip: Show what a click does and the area size next to the cursor.
FlowerPainter.Settings.PreviewDetail.Des: Simple updates the preview when you let go of a slider or corner and hides small objects; Detailed updates continuously.
FlowerPainter.Settings.SnapToRoadsWhenDr: Corners snap to the edges of nearby roads. The other snapping options are in the game's snapping menu.
FlowerPainter.Settings.SketchSurfaceFill: The sketch preview shades planned grass, paving and water with a faint tint. Turn off to see only their outlines.
FlowerPainter.Settings.KeepOffExistingRo: Drawn and painted areas stop at the edge of existing roads and sidewalks, so nothing is planned on the asphalt. Entrances move to the new edge.
FlowerPainter.Settings.LayoutSize.Desc: Scales the layout of every area type: path loops, spacing between benches and trees, plaza and feature sizes, margins. Trees, props and path widths keep their real size; parking stalls, roads, sports fields and golf greens keep real dimensions. 50% is the default; 100% is the original, roomier layout.
FlowerPainter.Settings.EdgeMargin.Desc: The one gap (in metres at 100% layout size) kept between the outline and paths or layout. Objects still keep their own footprint clear of the edge.
FlowerPainter.Settings.ToggleToolBinding: Opens or closes the FlowerPainter tool.
FlowerPainter.Settings.PrimaryBinding.De: Does what the main button says (next step, build…).
FlowerPainter.Settings.UndoBinding.Desc: Undo the last change to the area or design.
Removes every park, plaza, parking lot and road area built with FlowerPainter in this city.
Remove everything FlowerPainter built in this city? This cannot be undone.
FlowerPainter.Settings.ResetDefaults.Des: Resets these options and forgets the layer defaults you saved.
FlowerPainter.Settings.ResetDefaults.War: Reset all FlowerPainter options and saved layer defaults?
FlowerPainter.Permanent.Paint: Ground paint, about {0} m² — stays if the build is removed.
FlowerPainter.Problem.NoLineWalls: The bucket needs a line wall: turn on Roads, Paths, Bike paths or Rail.
FlowerPainter.Problem.OnlyWallsHere: Only walls here (water, lots or zoning). Click open land.
FlowerPainter.Hint.PerimeterAutoClose: The gap closes itself (dashed); Next to go on
FlowerPainter.Settings.BucketWallRoads.D: Every car road (alleys, gravel, one-way, pedestrian streets) bounds the bucket's fill.
FlowerPainter.Settings.BucketWallPaths.D: Pedestrian paths split blocks like streets do.
FlowerPainter.Settings.BucketWallBikes.D: Bicycle-only paths split blocks like streets do.
FlowerPainter.Settings.BucketWallTracks: Paint bucket walls: rail and tram
Train and tram tracks at ground level split blocks.
FlowerPainter.Settings.BucketWallWater.D: The fill stops at the water's edge and keeps the side you clicked.
FlowerPainter.Settings.BucketWallLots: Paint bucket walls: lots and buildings
FlowerPainter.Settings.BucketWallLots.De: The fill stops at buildings, other lots and your other builds, keeping the side you clicked.
FlowerPainter.Settings.BucketWallZoned.D: The fill stops at zoned cells, keeping the side you clicked.
FlowerPainter.Problem.FillOnWall: That spot is a road or something else it stops at. Click the land next to it.
FlowerPainter.Problem.FillTooSmall: Too small to fill here. Lower Gaps to reach narrow places.
FlowerPainter.Hint.DrawNodes: On a road node: two in a row follow the road
FlowerPainter.Settings.BrushStopPaths.De: Points, Paint bucket and Paint area keep off footpaths.
FlowerPainter.Settings.BrushStopBikes.De: Points, Paint bucket and Paint area keep off bike paths.
FlowerPainter.Settings.BrushStopTracks: Stop at rail and tram tracks
FlowerPainter.Settings.BrushStopTracks.D: Points, Paint bucket and Paint area keep off train and tram tracks on the ground.
FlowerPainter.Settings.AreaGap.Desc: Openings narrower than this count as closed for the Paint bucket and Paint area's One block, and places narrower than it are left out. 0 = off.
FlowerPainter.Settings.AreaReach.Desc: How far the Paint bucket spreads from where you click. In open land it fills a circle this size.
